sanskrit: sapatnahanam ṛṣabhaṃ ghṛtena kāmaṃ śikṣāmi haviṣājyena | nīcaiḥ sapatnān mama pādaya tvam abhiṣṭuto mahatā vīryeṇa ||
english: With ghee, with an oblation of clarified fat, I propitiate Kāma, the bull who slays rivals. Do thou, praised with great might, cast down my rivals low.

sanskrit: yan me manaso na priyaṃ na cakṣuṣo yan me hṛdaye nābhinandati | tad duṣvapnyaṃ prati muñcāmi sapatne kāmaṃ tuṣṭuvān ud ahaṃ bhideyam ||
english: Whatever is not dear to my mind, not pleasing to my eye, whatever does not gladden my heart — that ill-dream I release upon my rival. Having duly praised Kāma, may I break free and rise.

sanskrit: duṣvapnyaṃ kāma duritaṃ ca kāma- -aprajastām asvakṛtām avartim | ugra īśānaḥ prati muñca tasmin yo asmabhyam aṃhūraṇā cikitsāt ||
english: O Kāma, release upon him the ill-dream, O Kāma the misdeed, childlessness, the indigence not of our making — O fierce lord, release it upon him who has treated us with hostility.

sanskrit: sā te kāma duhitā dhenur ucyate yām āhur vācaṃ kavayo virājam | tayā sapatnān pari vṛṅdhi ye mama pary enān prāṇaḥ prajāḥ paśavo jīvanaṃ vṛṇaktu ||
english: She who is called thy daughter, O Kāma, the cow, whom the seers name Speech, the far-shining — with her encircle my rivals; may life-breath, offspring, cattle, and vitality pass around them and encompass me.

sanskrit: kāmasyendrasya varuṇasya rājño viṣṇor balena savituḥ savena | agner hotreṇa pra ṇuda sapatnān śambīva nāvam udakeṣu dhīraḥ ||
english: By the power of Kāma, by the might of Indra, by the sovereignty of King Varuṇa, by Viṣṇu's strength, by Savitṛ's creative impulse, by Agni's priestly office — drive forth the rivals, as a helmsman a boat through the waters.

sanskrit: adhyakṣo vājī mama kāma ugraḥ kṛṇotu mahyam asapatnam eva | viśve devā mama nāthaṃ bhavantu sarve devā havam ā yantu ma imam ||
english: May Kāma, my fierce overlord, the prize-winner, make for me a world without rivals. May all the Viśvedevāḥ be my protectors; may all the gods come to this my invocation.

sanskrit: idam ājyaṃ ghṛtavaj juṣāṇāḥ kāmajyeṣṭhā iha mādayantām | kṛṇvantu mahyam asapatnam eva ||
english: May those for whom Kāma is the foremost delight in this clarified fat and ghee here; may they make for me a world without rivals.

sanskrit: indrāgnī kāma sarathaṃ hi bhūtvā nīcaiḥ sapatnān mama pādayātha | teṣāṃ pannānām adhamā tamāṃsy agne vāstūny anunirdahā tvam ||
english: O Kāma, having mounted the same chariot as Indra and Agni, cast down my rivals low; and those who have fallen — their lowest dwellings, O Agni, burn through entirely.

sanskrit: jahi tvaṃ kāma mama ye sapatnā andhā tamāṃsy ava pādayainān | anindriyā arasāḥ santu sarve yathā na jivāt katamac canaiṣām ||
english: Slay, O Kāma, those who are my rivals; cast them down into blind darkness. May they all be devoid of vital force and strength, so that not one of them shall remain alive.

sanskrit: avadhīt kāmo mama ye sapatnā uruṃ lokam akaran mahyam edhatum | mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaś catasro mahyaṃ ṣaḍ urvīr ghṛtam ā vahantu ||
english: Kāma has slain those who were my rivals and has made broad space for my flourishing. May the four cardinal quarters bow to me; may the six vast realms bring me ghee.

sanskrit: yat te kāma śarma trivarūtham udbhid brahma varma vitatam anativyādhyaṃ kṛtam | tena sapatnān pari vṛṅdhi ye mama pary enān prāṇaḥ prajāḥ paśavo jīvanaṃ vṛṇaktu ||
english: That shelter of thine, O Kāma, triple-sheathed, the piercer, the spread-out armour of sacred power that is made impenetrable — with that encircle my rivals; may life-breath, offspring, cattle, and vitality pass around them and encompass me.

sanskrit: adharāñcaḥ pra plavantāṃ chinnā naur iva bandhanāt | na sāyakapraṇuttānāṃ punar asti nivartanam ||
english: May they drift away downward, like a boat cut from its mooring. For those driven off by the arrow there is no returning.

sanskrit: agnir yava indro yavaḥ somo yavaḥ | yavayāvāno deva yāvayantv amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putraṃ jīvalokān mṛtalokaṃ gatāsum ||
english: Agni is the averter, Indra is the averter, Soma is the averter. O ye gods who drive away, drive that man — yonder son of yonder woman — from the world of the living to the world of the dead, the departed.

sanskrit: asarvavīraś carati praṇutto mitrāṇāṃ dveṣyaḥ parivargyaḥ svānām | uta pṛthivyām ava syanti vidyuta ugro devaḥ pra mṛṇat sapatnān ||
english: He wanders bereft of all heroes, driven off, hateful to friends, shunned by his own kin. And even lightnings strike down upon the earth — may the fierce god crush the rivals.

sanskrit: cyutā ceyaṃ bṛhaty acyutā ca vidyud bibharti stanayitnūṃś ca sarvān | teṣām ādityo draviṇena tejasā- -udyan sapatnān nudatāṃ me sahasvān ||
english: This great lightning, both the fallen and the unfallen, bears all thunderclaps. May Āditya, rising with his wealth of brilliance, drive off my rivals with power.

sanskrit: yathā devā asurān prāṇudanta yena- -indro dasyūn adhamaṃ tamo babādhe | tathā tvaṃ kāma mama ye sapatnās tān asmāl lokāt pra ṇudasva sarvān ||
english: As the gods drove off the Asuras, as Indra pressed the Dasyus into the lowest darkness — so do thou, O Kāma, drive all those who are my rivals away from this world.

sanskrit: yena devā asurān prāṇudanta viśvahā yenendro dasyūn adhamaṃ tamo babādhe | tena tvaṃ kāma mama ye sapatnās tān asmāl lokāt pra ṇudasva dūram ||
english: By that same means by which the gods always drove off the Asuras, by which Indra pressed the Dasyus into the lowest darkness — by that, O Kāma, drive those who are my rivals far away from this world.

sanskrit: kāmo jajñe prathamo nānyat purā nainaṃ devā āpuḥ pitaro nota martyāḥ | tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nāma it kṛṇomi ||
english: Kāma was born first of all; before him there was nothing else. Neither the gods nor the Pitṛs nor mortals have attained unto him. Therefore thou art ever the greater, the mighty — to thee, O Kāma, homage alone I render.

sanskrit: na vai vātaś cana kāmam āpa nāgniḥ sūryo nota candramāḥ | (…) ||
english: Not even the wind has attained Kāma, nor fire, nor the sun, nor the moon. [...]

sanskrit: na vā āpaś cana kāmam āpur nāhorātrāṇi vihitāni yanti | (…) || ||
english: Not even the waters have attained Kāma; the appointed days and nights do not reach him. [...]

sanskrit: na vai puṇyajanāś cana kāmam āpur na gandharvāpsaraso na sarpāḥ | tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi ||
english: Not even the Puṇyajanas have attained Kāma, nor the Gandharvas and Apsarasas, nor the serpents. Therefore thou art ever the greater, the mighty — to thee, O Kāma, homage alone I render.

sanskrit: yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī varimṇā yāvad āpaḥ siṣyadur yāvad agniḥ | tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi ||
english: As wide as heaven and earth in their expanse, as far as the waters have streamed, as far as fire reaches — so far thou art ever the greater, the mighty; to thee, O Kāma, homage alone I render.

sanskrit: yāvatīr diśaḥ pradiśo viṣūcīr yāvatīr āśā abhicakṣaṇā divaḥ | tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi ||
english: As many as are the directions, the intermediate quarters reaching everywhere, as many as are the hopes that look upon the sky — so far thou art ever the greater, the mighty; to thee, O Kāma, homage alone I render.

sanskrit: yāvatīr bhṛṅgā jatvaḥ kurūravo yāvatīr vaghā vṛkṣasarpyaḥ | tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi ||
english: As many as are the bees, the gnats, the kurūravaḥ, as many as are the vaghā creatures that creep upon trees — so far thou art ever the greater, the mighty; to thee, O Kāma, homage alone I render.

sanskrit: yās te śivās taṇvas kāma bhadrā yābhiḥ satyaṃ bhavati yad vṛṇīte | tābhiṣ ṭvam asmān upa saṃ viśasva- -anyatra pāpīr apa veśayā dhiyaḥ ||
english: Those auspicious, gracious forms of thine, O Kāma, by which that which one chooses comes to be true — with those enter into us fully; drive the evil thoughts elsewhere away.
